text:
[Council File 26-0703]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (JURADO – BLUMENFIELD) relative to placing a measure on the ballot that would amend the Charter to allow the Council to remove a General Manager or Department Head by a two-thirds vote from their position with a City Department, Office or Board.
Recommendation for Council action:
REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present the documents necessary to place a measure on the November 2026 ballot that would amend the Charter to allow the Council to remove a General Manager or Department Head by a two-thirds vote from their position with a City Department, Office or Board.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Ad Hoc Committee on Charter Review Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
summary: Council would ask the City Attorney to draft a November 2026 charter amendment letting two-thirds of Council remove a General Manager or Department Head from their position.
